other_conditions: Applicants must be residents of Meghalaya living in remote and inaccessible areas situated near the international border.
benefits_summary: Provides infrastructure and socio‑economic development projects to improve the lives of residents in Meghalaya's border areas.
application_link: The Directorate of Border Areas Development submits proposals to Border Areas Development Department, the Department then forwards the same to Planning and Finance Departments for approval and sanction.
